Title: Application Insights support for Windows Phone and Windows Store

Body.Content: Application Insights supports collecting telemetry from Windows Phone and Windows Store apps and lets you visualize it in the Azure Preview portal. You can get insights about your users and what they are doing with your app, in addition to diagnosing and fixing your app crashes. When you add Application Insights to your project, a rich set of data, including users, sessions, page views, crashes is collected automatically. In addition, there is an API for you to send custom events, metrics, and exceptions.  Learn more and get started with Application Insights for device apps Visual Studio Application Insights is in preview.
Body.Markdown:
Application Insights supports collecting telemetry from Windows Phone and Windows Store apps and lets you visualize it in the Azure Preview portal. You can get insights about your users and what they are doing with your app, in addition to diagnosing and fixing your app crashes. When you add Application Insights to your project, a rich set of data, including users, sessions, page views, crashes is collected automatically. In addition, there is an API for you to send custom events, metrics, and exceptions.

Learn more and get started with Application Insights for device apps

Visual Studio Application Insights is in preview.
